readings: For each time in force (orders.timespan), using risk/margin records joined to orders on riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault (unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the count of matched risk/margin records, that count's share of the overall matched total (as a fraction, count / total), and the signed difference (share minus the average share across time-in-force values). No rounding.

For each time in force (orders.timespan), using risk/margin records joined to orders on riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault (unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the count of matched risk/margin records, that count's share of the overall matched total (as a fraction, count / total), and the absolute difference (the absolute value of share minus the average share across time-in-force values). No rounding.
queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS record_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg
FROM s;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS record_count, share, ABS(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS abs_diff_from_avg_share
FROM shares;
